overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance data reveals that space and planetary 'what-if' scenarios, as well as extreme cosmic extremes (e.g., extreme planets, diamond/burning-ice worlds), are driving the highest views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes-per-view). Videos published within the last 7 days featuring immersive situational hooks ('What If You Fell Into...') outperform generic factual statements. Conversely, purely abstract psychological facts or minor biological trivia without high-stakes visual implications show lower traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) generated over 970-1,000+ views rapidly with high like ratios (38 likes).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical extreme planetary survival scenarios with high-stakes visual hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) and 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) achieved over 700-1,000 views with strong viewer retention signals.
winning_patterns.action: Continue producing short-form deep dives into bizarre exoplanet weather conditions and extreme physics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos regarding earworms, memory creation, or basic human anatomy ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 2fqaGqfsR4A) stalled at under 10-50 views.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize low-visual psychological trivia unless framed within an intense, cinematic mystery narrative.
